next_step: POC: ingestion of sample 10M ticket docs + measure 95th pctile end-to-end latency and top-5 rerank accuracy
notes:
Context: Zenora builds a multi-tenant customer support platform used by e-comm and fintech customers across EU. They want to add an embeddings+rerank RAG layer to power a support agent + ticket deflection flow. Key asks: handle ~5–20M indexed ticket & KB docs, sub-200ms p95 retrieval+rerank for UI-first deflection, top-5 rerank quality > 88% (human eval), and target cost per end-user query <= $0.005 (embeddings+compute+storage amortized).

POC scope discussed:
- Ingest 10M historical tickets + KB + transcripts (1.2TB text) to test index scale and vector store throughput.
- Baseline: semantic search (hosted vector store) + light transformer reranker (distil-size) hosted on dedicated GPUs for rerank; compare to an all-hosted API option.
- Measure E2E p50/p95 latency, token cost per query, and rerank MRR/top5 accuracy on 200 labeled queries.

Quoted requirements / customer language: "Customer care SLA is sensitive — experience must feel instant. If search takes >250ms we lose deflection." Also: "We need proof we can keep cost predictable at scale."

Security: must meet EU data residency, SSO (SAML), SOC2. Legal flagged retention policy: 18 months specialized retention for PII redaction; audit log access for data lineage.

Internal notes / sales shorthand:
- Very risk-averse ops team. Security review in flight with OWASP + infra diagrams requested.
- Interested in Dedicated for predictable throughput; asking about on-prem/private later for top-tier customers.
- Wants routing: fast retrieval from EU region + fallback to a cheaper quantized reranker if dedicated capacity is saturated.

References: drive deck has traffic patterns (expected 30k qps peak across clients, but per-customer qps ~ 20–100). Expect typical query: user prompt + 3–5 retrieved docs -> rerank -> generate final answer.

Sales cues: price sensitivity but will pay for SLAs; mention of competitor pilots with Pinecone + small-run reranker. We should push Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/kv-cache and show projected unit economics.

Decision makers: Head of Product (Lucia Meyer), Head of Ops (Jakub Novak), Legal (Sophie Laurent).
